remaining_blockers: GEOMETRIC BRIDGE (missing construction, not assumed anywhere): for a complete Riemannian manifold with radial sectional curvatures (or Ric) bounded below by (n−1)K, prove that the (n−1)-volume density A t of the geodesic spheres satisfies A'/A = tr S/(n−1) with the shape-operator Riccati equation S' + S² + R_γ = 0 and the Cauchy-Schwarz step tr S² ≥ (tr S)²/(n−1), hence m' + m²/d + K ≤ 0 and the Euclidean normalization near 0. Needs a Riemannian-geometry framework (exponential map, Jacobi fields, sphere measures) — not present in the release package; upstream candidates: MorganTian/DoCarmo/LeeLib in third_party/frenzymath (book formalizations, not Lean proofs).

MODEL VOLUME CONSTANT: the geometric model volume is V̄ t = ω_{n−1}·∫₀ᵗ j_K(s)^(n−1) ds where ω_{n−1} is the measure of the Euclidean unit (n−1)-sphere; a mathlib API check for that constant is still open. All D12 volume-ratio statements are scale-free (ratios), so the constant cancels; it is needed only for absolute volume statements.

RAUCH COROLLARY BRIDGE: the one-sided Rauch corollaries u ≤ j_K (k ≥ K) and u ≥ j_K (k ≤ K) for the scalar Jacobi solution u versus the D10 model j_K are the natural next downstream uses of riccati_le/ge_of_singular_normalization with d = 1; missing pieces (planned, not yet proved): (i) the quantitative normalization lemma |u t/t − 1| ≤ B·t and |du t − 1| ≤ B·t from u 0 = 0, du 0 = 1, |ddu| ≤ B (double mean-value theorem); (ii) the model normalization |jacobiSol K t/t − 1| ≤ √|K|·t·(1/6) for K ≥ 0 via abs_sub_sin_le; (iii) the ratio-limit argument u ε/j_K ε → 1. The mirrored singular comparison riccati_ge_of_singular_normalization needed for the lower direction is already proved.

HYPERBOLIC MODEL NORMALIZATION: for K < 0 the quantitative bound |sinh(√(−K)t)/(√(−K)t) − 1| ≤ C·t is not yet formalized (series or convexity bound); the spherical/flat cases suffice for the first Rauch corollary.

remaining_blockers: B1 (the mathematical blocker): invariance of the PSD cone under the CORRECT condition. Exact missing statement: for n finite and P : Matrix n n R -> Matrix n n R continuous (or locally Lipschitz) with forall A, A.PosSemidef -> KernelTangent A (P A), every differentiable M : R -> Matrix n n R with forall t >= 0, deriv M t = P (M t) and M 0 >= 0 satisfies forall t >= 0, (M t).PosSemidef. Needed ingredients: the min-eigenvalue (Danskin) comparison D+ lambda_min(M t) >= min {v^T P(M t) v : ||v|| = 1, M t v = lambda_min(M t) v} and a first-exit argument. Both mathlib spectral tools (Matrix.IsHermitian.eigenvalues, eigenvectorBasis, spectral_theorem) are present in the pinned revision; this is a formalisation blocker, not missing mathematics. The statement is NOT assumed anywhere; the strict variant StrictKernelTangent -> FeasibleDirection is also not proved.

Alexander trick: alexanderHomeo n h : Disk (n+1) ≃ₜ Disk (n+1) with alexanderHomeo_sphereToDisk (boundary restriction), alexanderHomeo_refl / alexanderHomeo_zero (degeneracy) and alexanderHomeo_eq_refl_iff (nondegeneracy); used as the engine of the gluing theorem.
